subject: [PATCH v4 03/19] selftests/mm: scale khugepaged's collapse wait with the PMD size

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Expressed concern that the patch may make selftest runs too long, suggested exploring alternative solutions to trim down wait time. Acknowledged the patch as reasonable and applied ACK.

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch adjusts the wait time in khugepaged's collapse function to scale with PMD size, ensuring that large page builds don't timeout unnecessarily. The adjustment is based on empirical data from arm64 systems with 64K pages, where the original three-second wait was deemed too short.
